construction_method: Rolled membership backward from upstream Jan 1 2015 list and forward-validated year-to-year continuity.

known_symbol_notes.BKNG: Used to align with upstream 2015 file, though historical Nasdaq-100 table used PCLN before Booking Holdings ticker rename.
known_symbol_notes.MNST/HANS: Hansen Natural changed to Monster Beverage ticker MNST on 2012-01-09; a synthetic ticker rename row is included in 2012. Note MNST was also used historically by Monster Worldwide before removal in 2008.
known_symbol_notes.QRTEA/LINTA: 2006 Liberty Interactive addition normalized to QRTEA for compatibility with upstream 2015 ticker conventions.
known_symbol_notes.WFM/WFMI: Whole Foods represented as WFM for compatibility with upstream 2015 file.
known_symbol_notes.CMCSK: 2014 source table lists CMCSK as a second Comcast class, but upstream 2015 file has CMCSA rather than CMCSK; omitted to avoid adding a symbol not present upstream.
known_symbol_notes.HSIC: Upstream 2015 file contains HSIC, but public change tables found during this run show a 2004 removal and no clear re-add before 2015; included as a synthetic 2014-12-22 union row so the backfill remains forward-consistent.
known_symbol_notes.RHAT: Red Hat was added in 2005 and moved from Nasdaq to NYSE in December 2006; represented as a removal-only row for continuity.
known_symbol_notes.KFT/MDLZ/KRFT: KFT addition in 2012 is followed by a synthetic KFT->MDLZ ticker-change row on 2012-10-02; KRFT remains as a separate later Kraft Foods Group symbol.

canonical_data_note: Canonical 2015-2026 files in src/ are copied from jmccarrell/n100tickers raw files as downloaded on 2026-05-05. Canonical 2004-2014 files are reconstructed research-grade backfill.
